review_method: Independent original map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, independently registered outlines, wider context, imprints and credits. All 113 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with freshly reopened complete source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins. Each original primary viewport, projected coordinate system and full-precision GPTS/LPTS controls was reopened. Full six-parameter affines retain both cross terms and explicitly apply original MediaBox/CropBox offsets. Eight Northern and 105 West-Central ordered-position registrations were independently recomputed; all six original detail/context pixel arrays and four credit/imprint arrays match fresh PDF renders. Maximum control residuals are below 0.001 PDF point, measuring affine consistency rather than shoreline accuracy. First pixel observations were recorded before comparison with source-research conclusions. All three full-feature correspondence reviews are complete at bounded naming-scope assessment, yielding three holds. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
